UI.scope: DetailTagInteractionV51UITests (4) and three affected CompactHeadersV42UITests: select/new/merge/cancel/submit, saved-query retention, excluded tags, Library and Reader entries, single-line input, light and dark large-type headers

interaction.tag_tap: Toggle selection without executing or mutating the active search
interaction.new_search: Selected tags only, presented as an editable draft
interaction.add_to_current_search: Copy the executed query, retain existing conditions and de-duplicate tags; hidden when no active conditions
interaction.existing_exclusions: Retained and explicitly identified in the composer
interaction.execution: Explicit composer Search action only; modal dismissal completes before navigation
interaction.cancel: Retain original results, selected tags and saved combinations
interaction.saved_combinations: Updated only by an explicit save
interaction.bulk_tag_management: One atomic local write per batch; newly blocked tags can be undone
interaction.single_line_search: Return ends editing; loaded and pasted line breaks become spaces

appearance.visual_review: Completed for normal light, dark large type, search menu, merge draft and floating header

limitations: UI checks use isolated neutral fixtures; phone installation and real-device UI acceptance are separate stages.
The reported single-gallery authentication message has not been reproduced against its actual response; no authentication or network parser fix is claimed.
Real-site speed, Cloudflare verification and account or payment operations are not established by these checks.
